description: This file defines an interface for a grain in Orleans, specifically for reminder testing purposes. It declares asynchronous methods to check, add, and remove reminders by name.

classes.name: IReminderTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that handles reminder operations, including checking existence, adding, and removing reminders.

methods.name: IsReminderExists
methods.description: Asynchronously checks whether a reminder with the specified name exists.

methods.name: AddReminder
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a reminder with the given name.

methods.name: RemoveReminder
methods.description: Asynchronously removes a reminder with the given name.
